what: the runner's own check after rollout astra_ring_001 (no code of the model, no exam data): the evaluator's own scoring functions (vw.scoring.energy_fair for a 32-member ensemble, energy_loo for the oracle) on a made-up truth N(0, I_d) with R = 16 replicate truths per item and 4000 items. Ensembles drawn FROM THE TRUE LAW: independent draws, 16 antithetic pairs, 32 scrambled Sobol points through the normal quantile function. Each entry: [mean, standard error]; the *_minus_oracle entries: [mean paired difference, its standard error, the difference as a share of the oracle's score].
reading: independent draws from the truth score as the leave-one-out oracle does (the fair estimator is unbiased for them); negatively dependent draws from the same law score 1.3 % (antithetic) to 2.1-2.4 % (Sobol) BELOW the oracle. The oracle row O is therefore not a ceiling for a submission that chooses its 32 samples jointly.
